semantic_inputs: current role-local payload path Git blob SHA

milestone.name: premise-origin policy + content-addressed reuse gate
milestone.revision: PCBE premises are now typed by origin. REPO_IDENTITY may support exact path/blob identity equality; DECLARED_CONFIG supports only conditional reasoning; DERIVED requires checked parents; EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION fails closed without a separate valid certificate. Combining a live Git blob identity with a declared release flag gives a reuse-only RELEASE_OK gate that requires no rebuild or byte-faithful binary readback and rejects changed flag, changed expected SHA and unsupported ambient compiler claims.

reuse_gate.scope: one already-present Git blob identity plus one declared config flag

fresh_artifact_production.reason: identity gate can only reuse an artifact that already exists

binary_semantic_verification.reason: Git SHA identity does not reveal or prove arbitrary binary semantics without a separate trusted mapping/certificate

ambient_environment_measurement.reason: DECLARED_CONFIG is not an observation of the physical environment

negative_evidence: A digest can be an exact identity premise without being a byte-semantic premise.
A declared configuration value cannot be silently promoted to an observed machine fact.
Reuse-only gating eliminates rebuilding only when the required artifact identity already exists and is readable as repository metadata.
Cryptographic signature verification must not be claimed merely because a signature/attestation document is present; actual verification needs an exposed verifier or a bounded checkable certificate.

frontier.action: Construct a multi-artifact reuse manifest from two or more current role-local Git blob identities plus declared configuration and prove a selection predicate. Inject one stale/mismatched identity and one config mismatch; require fail-closed. Measure metadata reads and proof records to see whether the capsule scales linearly.

Audit signed-attestation verification surfaces that may expose a provider-verified status as repository metadata. Distinguish provider-asserted verified status from raw signature bytes that would require cryptographic execution. Reject any optional quota or hosted verification dependency.

Explore whether small declarative test or configuration outcomes can be transformed into PCBE certificates automatically by Chat from source text alone without introducing an unbounded parser/semantic model; preserve unsupported constructs as explicit unresolved children.

exact_next_action: Use current role-local files from the r145 transaction capsule (manifest blob aec4e6979911cf7b116ef0f17db8067c00f6d982 and payload blob 0b7cb3e94d8fb7537e5544a2345a195f0f36934d) as two REPO_IDENTITY premises. Define a reuse manifest rule requiring RELEASE_MODE=1 and both exact identities. Re-read both current path SHAs, derive RELEASE_OK once, then mutate each identity and the config separately. Count repository identity reads and PCBE proof records; record whether complexity stays linear and no binary content or external executor is required.
termination: intermediate Phase-1 checkpoint with nonempty frontier; global completion false; recurring role remains enabled
